intro: Franky makes every square foot count. Its space-friendly design, smart proportions, and strong materials make small dining areas feel spacious, stylish, and comfortable.

features.title: Durable top that resists daily wear
features.text: Crafted from high-density moisture-resistant board, our tabletop stands up to spills, scratches, and daily dining — keeping its beauty intact for years.

features.title: Stone-inspired design for timeless style
features.text: The natural stone pattern, paired with a soft suede finish, adds warmth and texture — making your table feel inviting for everyday meals or special dinners.

features.title: Rounded corners for a safer space
features.text: Smooth, rounded edges offer a softer, safer design — perfect for homes with kids or compact rooms where every detail matters.

features.title: Strong metal legs for reliable support
features.text: Powder-coated black metal legs provide sturdy support and a modern touch, ensuring lasting stability for all your family meals.

name: Franky 4-Seater Engineered Wood Square Dining Table
